timeline.summary: Wheels India acquired an 18.87% post-dilution stake in Emerge Solar One Private Limited for ₹3.43 Cr for captive solar power.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,564.02 Cr (+22.5% YoY), net profit ₹58.81 Cr (+52.6% YoY).
On May 15, 2026, Wheels India reported FY26 revenue of ₹5,124 Cr and net profit of ₹138.56 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹9.14 per share.
Wheels India Limited’s Board, chaired by **Srivats Ram**, recommended a final dividend of ₹9.14 per equity share (91.4%) for FY2025-26, payable by July 30, 2026, subject to AGM approval.
Wheels India Limited held a conference call with fund managers, analysts, and investors on May 15, 2026, at 3:30 PM (IST) via presentation link provided.
K V Lakshmi, Director, shared conference call recording with fund managers, analysts, and investors on May 15, 2026, at 3:30 PM (IST).
On May 20, 2026, Wheels India announced a 50:50 joint venture agreement with Bosch Limited and Brakes India for commercial vehicle air systems.
Wheels India Limited scheduled a conference call with fund managers, analysts, and investors from September 7–9, 2026, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM.
ICRA upgraded Wheels India's long-term credit rating to [ICRA]A+ (Stable) and short-term rating to [ICRA]A1.
